description: Bring a deactivated client back to the registry.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

name: reactivate_client

outputSchema.description: One client the company keeps between issuances.

id.description: Pass it as client_id to issue_invoice or save_client.

source.description: manual, issued (imported from issued invoices) or issuance (saved by an issuance).

tax_id.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters, unpunctuated). A CNPJ may carry letters in its first 12 positions since July 2026, so never treat it as a number.
